title: Dataplane
intro: VPP start-up tuning: worker threads and their cores, DPDK NICs with their queues and descriptors, hugepages and buffers, and plugin switches. Save to the candidate and commit with the pending-change bar; use Preview to see the startup.conf the router would install.
restartBanner: These settings are written to the VPP start-up configuration and take effect only after a VPP restart, which interrupts all forwarding. Committing them does not change the running data plane.

preview.title: startup.conf preview (candidate)
preview.changed: The rendered file differs from the installed one: installing it needs a VPP restart.
preview.unchanged: The rendered file is identical to the installed one: nothing would change.

apply.disabled: Not available yet: installing startup.conf restarts VPP and waits for the appliance approval gate (TD-17). A manager installs it with apply-startup.sh.

workers.title: Worker threads
workers.help: Number of worker threads; 0 runs the graph on the main thread only.

corelist.title: Worker cores
corelist.help: CPU ids pinned to worker threads; when set, the worker count must equal its length.

mainCore.title: Main core
mainCore.help: CPU id of the main thread; must not be a worker core.

rxQueues.title: RX queues per NIC
rxQueues.help: Default number of receive queues per DPDK NIC.

txQueues.title: TX queues per NIC
txQueues.help: Default number of transmit queues per DPDK NIC.

hugepagesGb.title: Hugepages (GB)
hugepagesGb.help: Total hugepage memory reserved for the data plane.

pciWhitelist.title: PCI whitelist
pciWhitelist.help: NICs handed to DPDK; empty means no DPDK devices.

managementPci.title: Management NICs
managementPci.help: Always blacklisted, never handed to DPDK.

devices.title: DPDK devices
devices.help: NICs handed to DPDK by PCI address, each with its logical interface name.

buffersPerNuma.title: Buffers per NUMA node
buffersPerNuma.help: Must fit in the hugepage reservation.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.help: When present, exactly these switches are rendered; when absent, the switches of the installed file are kept.

switches.title: Plugin switches
switches.help: Plugin file, on to enable or off to disable.

live.title: Candidate and running
live.note: Running is the committed configuration. VPP keeps using the installed start-up file until it restarts.
